change.summary: Operators must exercise due diligence and submit a due diligence statement before placing relevant products on the market. They must also keep records, inform authorities of risks, and assist with checks. This applies to operators placing relevant products on the EU market.

obligations.text: Exercise due diligence before placing relevant products on the market.
obligations.quote: Operators shall exercise due diligence in accordance with Article 8 prior to placing relevant products on the market or exporting them in order to prove that the relevant products comply with Article 3.

obligations.text: Submit a due diligence statement before placing relevant products on the market.
obligations.quote: Operators shall not place relevant products on the market or export them without prior submission of a due diligence statement.

obligations.text: Do not place products on the market if due diligence reveals a non-negligible risk of non-compliance.
obligations.quote: the exercise of due diligence has revealed a non-negligible risk that the relevant products are non-compliant;

obligations.text: Do not place products on the market if unable to fulfil due diligence obligations.
obligations.quote: the operator was unable to fulfil the obligations referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2.

obligations.text: Inform competent authorities of new information indicating product risk.
obligations.quote: Operators that obtain or are made aware of relevant new information, including substantiated concerns, indicating that a relevant product that they have placed on the market is at risk of not complying with this Regulation shall immediately inform the competent authorities of the Member States in which they placed the relevant product on the market, as well as downstream operators and traders to whom they supplied the relevant product.

obligations.text: Offer assistance to competent authorities for checks.
obligations.quote: Operators shall offer all necessary assistance to the competent authorities to facilitate the carrying out of the checks under Article 18, including access to premises and the making available of documentation and records.

obligations.text: Communicate due diligence statement reference numbers to downstream operators.
obligations.quote: Operators shall communicate to downstream operators and to traders further down the supply chain of the relevant products they placed on the market or exported the reference numbers of the due diligence statements or, if applicable, the declaration identifiers associated to those products.

reasons: Applies because you are established in Germany and sell wooden furniture and leather goods, which are relevant products under the EU Deforestation Regulation.
You ship to multiple EU countries, so you are placing relevant products on the EU market as an operator.
The obligations are addressed to operators who place relevant products on the market, which matches your business activity.

todos.text: Set up a due diligence process for your wood furniture and leather goods before listing them
todos.quote: Operators shall exercise due diligence in accordance with Article 8 prior to placing relevant products on the market or exporting them in order to prove that the relevant products comply with Article 3.

todos.text: Submit a due diligence statement via the EU information system before listing new wood or leather products
todos.quote: Operators shall not place relevant products on the market or export them without prior submission of a due diligence statement.

todos.text: Remove any wood or leather product from your store if due diligence shows a non-negligible risk of non-compliance
todos.quote: the exercise of due diligence has revealed a non-negligible risk that the relevant products are non-compliant;

todos.text: Create a process to immediately notify national authorities in each EU country you ship to if you learn of compliance risks for your wood or leather products
todos.quote: Operators that obtain or are made aware of relevant new information, including substantiated concerns, indicating that a relevant product that they have placed on the market is at risk of not complying with this Regulation shall immediately inform the competent authorities of the Member States in which they placed the relevant product on the market, as well as downstream operators and traders to whom they supplied the relevant product.

todos.text: Prepare to give authorities access to your premises, records and documentation for EUDR checks
todos.quote: Operators shall offer all necessary assistance to the competent authorities to facilitate the carrying out of the checks under Article 18, including access to premises and the making available of documentation and records.

todos.text: Pass on due diligence statement reference numbers to your business customers when you supply them wood furniture or leather goods
todos.quote: Operators shall communicate to downstream operators and to traders further down the supply chain of the relevant products they placed on the market or exported the reference numbers of the due diligence statements or, if applicable, the declaration identifiers associated to those products.
